title: Creature, Monster, NPC Role, Behavior & Combat-Package Authoring

selection_basis.reduced_strict_order: MRCS-11 → MRCS-12 → MRCS-13 → MRCS-14 → MRCS-16 → MRCS-17 → MRCS-19 → MRCS-21

objective: Author creature, monster, NPC-role, behavior, combat, defense, resource, habitat and taxonomy packages as reusable definitions over existing creature/NPC/Action/combat owners without creating encounter instances or autonomously mutating NPC truth.
acceptance: creature definitions remain distinct from encounter instances
behavior packages cannot autonomously mutate NPC truth
boundaries: MRCS-01/03/04/05/08/11 remain the workspace, guided-authoring, bounded-expression, mechanical-definition, package-composition and magic-definition foundations consumed by this tranche.
Creature, monster, NPC-role, behavior and combat records remain reusable definitions/packages; live NPC/creature identity, state and encounter instances remain external owner-domain authority.
Behavior packages may reference governed actions, effects, conditions, resources and predicates but cannot autonomously execute actions or mutate NPC truth.
Combat/defense/resource/habitat/taxonomy semantics remain explicit owner references or definition data and cannot silently become a parallel NPC or encounter runtime.
Unknown creature/source semantics remain unresolved rather than inferred.
MRCS-13+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MSAS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
